description: Crime indexes for the 2020 census block group at a U.S. location. The location is one of: address, lat and lon, or bg_geoid (12 digits). Returns 16 crimes and four summaries with expected annual counts, indexes (100 = U.S. rate per resident), 80% intervals, confidence, national percentiles, city and county comparisons, and notes.
name: crime_index
title: Crime index
